title: The audio processor signalling handover every second
note: The crash memory of a stock boot showed 'Handover signaled, but it already happened' once a second from about 370 to 411 s, then audio playback. Not yet understood; may be related to the boots without a sound card.

title: Ask each camera slot what it is
note: The first step of the cameras: a test device tree that only powers a slot (supplies, clock, reset), booted once as the second entry; then the chip's identity register read over its control bus. Turns reported sensor models into facts.

title: Image sensors: described, then identified, then seen
note: Known (research/cameras.md): the pipeline and all three control buses are bound; no sensor is described, which alone is why the cameras are dark. The vendor's kernel gives the wiring of seven sensor slots - bus, lanes, supplies, pins, clock - and names no model. Next: power one slot at a time in a test device tree and ask the chip for its identity; describe fully what this kernel already has a driver for; a frame.

title: Sound recorded through the microphone
note: The codec is on the card in the test kernel. Next: its capture devices and mixer path, then a recording while the speaker plays a tone - so the check needs no ears.

title: The microphone codec times out at initialisation
note: Solved 2026-11-11: the audio pin driver muxed gpio19 (TX SoundWire data) to function 1 and gpio23 (RX data) to 3, where the phone's own Android kernel has 3 and 2. With both corrected the TX bus no longer clashes, the codec initialises and the sound card is made with the codec on it. The clocks going to 0 were a consequence, not the cause.

title: A SIM card in the phone
note: Needs the author: without a SIM the modem reports a failed state, so calls, messages and mobile data cannot be shown at all. The checks skip, and say why.

title: Boots that come up without the sound card
note: On 2026-11-11 one stock boot had no phone sound card: the audio processor ran with no crash, but its service channel (APR) never appeared, so no audio driver loaded. A reboot restored it. Next: a run of reboots to measure how often.

title: Sensors, without crashing the audio processor
note: No motion or light sensor is exposed: the sensor hub's service is masked because with it the audio processor crashed at every suspend. Sensors return when that crash is understood.
